story.title: A home kitchen, kept at the centre.
story.intro: GH Chikkis is a family-run, homemade chikki brand in Ahmedabad. These are the facts of our story — the rest is best told directly.
storyBody: GH Chikkis was established in 2018. It is run by sisters Gopi Shah and Himanisha, who are equal partners in the business.
The work began at home, and home is still the centre of it. The kitchen is where the recipes are made, the orders are packed and the standards are set.
We make chikki by hand. We do not present ourselves as a factory, a showroom or a large operation. We are a family kitchen, and we like it that way.
foundersBody: Gopi Shah and Himanisha are sisters and equal partners. They share the work of running GH Chikkis, from the kitchen to the people who order from us.
If you have a question about a variety, packaging or a bulk order, you are speaking to the family. We would rather tell you directly than invent a longer history.
timeline: 2018 — GH Chikkis is established in Ahmedabad.
The family kitchen — Gopi and Himanisha build the business as equal partners.
Today — a collection of seven chikki varieties, made by hand for customers in and around Ahmedabad.
story.closing: For current varieties, packaging and availability, ask us directly. The kitchen changes with the season and with what has been made that week.

process.title: Heat, patience, pressure, cut.
process.intro: Every variety passes through the same rhythm. The details change; the attention does not.

steps.title: The cook
steps.body: The base is brought to the right point over heat. The window is narrow; this stage is judged by eye, by aroma and by experience.

steps.title: The pour
steps.body: The hot base is poured over the nuts or other ingredients and spread quickly, before it begins to set.

steps.title: The press
steps.body: The mixture is pressed and rolled to an even thickness. An uneven press shows up later, in the bite.

steps.title: The cut
steps.body: While the set is still warm, it is marked and cut. The clean edge is the part we check first.

steps.title: The wrap
steps.body: Once cool, the pieces are broken along the cuts, sorted and packed. Every box is checked by hand.

process.closing: The illustrations on this page are a visual guide to the stages, not photographs of a specific batch. Ask us if you would like to see the current process directly.

faqs.title: Questions, answered.
faqs.intro: If your question is not here, ask us directly — we would rather give you a real answer.

faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: Use the enquiry form on this website or message us on WhatsApp. We confirm availability, packaging, price and collection or delivery directly with you. There is no online checkout.

faqs.question: Why are prices not shown?
faqs.answer: Every order can differ by variety, packaging and quantity. We share current prices directly so you have the right information for what you need.

faqs.question: What varieties do you make?
faqs.answer: Our current collection is listed on the Chikki Collection page. Ask us if you are looking for something not listed.

faqs.question: Can I choose a custom weight?
faqs.answer: We can discuss custom weights and packaging. Tell us what you need and we will confirm what is possible and the price before you order.

faqs.question: Do you deliver?
faqs.answer: We arrange home collection, porter or courier depending on the order. We confirm the method, timing and any charge with you in advance.

faqs.question: Do you make corporate or bulk orders?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell us the quantity, occasion and date through the gifting enquiry, and we will confirm details directly.

faqs.question: Can you tell me about ingredients and allergens?
faqs.answer: Please ask us for the current ingredients and allergen information for the specific variety you are considering. We do not publish unverified details.

faqs.question: How should I store chikki?
faqs.answer: Ask us for current storage guidance for the variety and packaging you choose. It can vary with the batch and the weather.

faqs.question: Can I visit the kitchen?
faqs.answer: GH Chikkis operates from a family kitchen, not a public showroom. Please contact us before planning a visit so we can tell you whether it is possible.

faqs.question: Do you ship outside Ahmedabad?
faqs.answer: Ask us. We will confirm whether courier delivery is available for your location and what it costs.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: Payment is arranged directly with us. We do not collect payment on this website.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: When you send an enquiry, we collect your name, phone number, optional email address, the quantity you are interested in and an optional expected date.
If you become a customer, we may also keep your address, company details, order history, payment records and notes needed to run the business.

sections.heading: Why we use it
body: To reply to your enquiry, prepare and deliver orders, keep invoices and payment records, and run the business. We do not sell your information.

sections.heading: WhatsApp
body: If you give us permission, we may contact you on WhatsApp about your enquiry or order. You can withdraw that permission at any time by telling us.
Automated messages are only sent where we have a recorded permission and a valid message setup.

sections.heading: Staff access
body: Only authorised team members can access customer and order data. Access is limited by role and recorded in our audit log.

sections.heading: Analytics
body: If analytics is enabled, we use Google Analytics 4 to understand how the website is used. It is loaded only after you accept analytics cookies.
We do not send your name, phone number, email address, order details or invoice numbers to analytics.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: The website uses a necessary session cookie for staff sign-in. Analytics cookies are optional and are loaded only with your consent.

sections.heading: Retention and backups
body: Business records such as invoices and payment records are kept as long as needed for the business and applicable obligations. Backups are encrypted and retained for up to 30 days.

sections.heading: Service providers
body: We use service providers for hosting, database, media storage, Google sign-in for staff and, where enabled, WhatsApp messaging and analytics. They process data on our behalf under their terms.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: You can ask us to correct your contact details or to stop WhatsApp contact. Use the contact form on this website.
We may need to keep records that we are required to keep for business or legal reasons.

sections.heading: About this website
body: This website introduces GH Chikkis and lets you send an enquiry. It does not sell products online, take payment or create a binding order.

sections.heading: Enquiries and orders
body: An enquiry is not an order. An order is confirmed only when GH Chikkis confirms availability, price, packaging and collection or delivery directly with you.

sections.heading: Prices and availability
body: Prices and availability are shared directly and may change. Nothing on this website is a price list or an offer for sale.

sections.heading: Product information
body: Product descriptions are provided for general information. For current ingredients, allergens and storage guidance, ask us before ordering.
Nothing on this website is medical or nutritional advice.

sections.heading: Delivery and collection
body: Collection, porter or courier options and any charges are confirmed with you before an order is accepted.
